sections.title: Use of Proceeds
sections.excerpt: Use of proceeds We intend to use approximately $300,000 of the net proceeds to repay in full our outstanding institutional convertible notes at the closing of this offering; approximately $2,400,000 to repay other outstanding indebtedness, including shareholder promissory notes, merchant cash advance obligations and trade payables, over time following the closing; approximately $9,980,000 for working capital and other general corporate purposes; and approximately $956,000 for potential strategic transactions, including mergers, acquisitions and business combinations. No specific acquisition targets have been identified as of the date of this prospectus.
